_comment: Shared backend registry. Each operator's dashboard reads this to populate the top-bar pill switcher. Backends run on operator machines (harsh-this-box, ikenna-this-box) and — eventually — VMs. Add a new entry for each backend you want the dashboard to be able to talk to.
_url_note: Use an empty string (or omit) when the backend is SAME-ORIGIN as wherever the dashboard is served. The dashboard falls back to BOOTSTRAP_URL (localhost:8765 in dev, same-origin in production behind nginx). Set a real URL for cross-machine backends — e.g. https://ikenna.epiphanytechnologies.com when Ikenna's box is reachable.
_integration_note: Read by the orchastrator backend via ORCHASTRATOR_BACKENDS env var. Source of truth lives here (in PM repo) so both operators see the same list.
